AfterSideTurnStart.issue: RE-READ 2026-07-30 (round 11): the entry's own citations (`powers.py:2751-2754 on_player_turn_started`) are STALE -- the code has moved twice since this text was drafted (per CONTRACT rule: re-execute the witness before trusting the prose). Today DrawCardsNextTurnPower's turn-start removal is `after_side_turn_start` (powers.py:3197-3200), a hook that DID NOT EXIST when this entry (or its 2026-07-27 narrowing) was written -- it is the sim's now-genuinely-separate port of `Hook.AfterSideTurnStart` (hooks.py:696-708, CombatManager.cs:522), split out from `on_player_turn_started` (`Hook.AfterPlayerTurnStart`, CombatManager.cs:675) by the round-5 turn_structure campaign (see this record's g2 guard, closed this same pass). SLOT IS NOW CORRECT, not merely 'right by luck' -- player.py:230-243 fires `after_side_turn_start` (:235) strictly after `_setup_player_turn`'s hand draw and strictly before `after_auto_pre_play_phase_entered` (:243), matching CombatManager.cs's SetupPlayerTurn -> AfterSideTurnStart -> AutoPrePlay order exactly. WHAT REMAINS, unchanged and RE-VERIFIED DORMANT rather than merely re-asserted: WRONG CONDITION. DrawCardsNextTurnPower.cs:37 removes the power only when `participants.Contains(base.Owner) && base.AmountOnTurnStart != 0`; powers.py:3197-3200 expires unconditionally, and `PowerModel.AmountOnTurnStart` (snapshotted in Creature.BeforeTurnStart, Creature.cs:673-679, guarding exactly 'prevent same-turn activation when applied mid-turn') still has no sim counterpart -- EXECUTED, re-run: `grep -rn amount_on_turn_start sts2_rl/` returns nothing. REACHABILITY, worked through explicitly against the NOW-SEPARATED phase order (not assumed): `AmountOnTurnStart == 0` at a given turn's `after_side_turn_start` requires the power to have been APPLIED, on THAT SAME creature, strictly between Creature.BeforeTurnStart's snapshot (before `before_side_turn_start`, player.py:200) and that turn's own `after_side_turn_start` (player.py:235) -- i.e. during `before_side_turn_start`, the block-clear, `on_player_turn_start` (BeforeHandDraw), the hand draw itself, or `on_player_turn_started` (AfterPlayerTurnStart). None of those slots can play a card: the ONLY ported applier of this power is the Relax card (cards/relax.py:42, a manual player-turn card play, which can only happen during PlayerTurnPhase.PLAY, itself entered only AFTER `after_auto_pre_play_phase_entered` at player.py:244 -- i.e. strictly AFTER this same turn's `after_side_turn_start` already fired) and MayhemPower's auto-play, which now runs from `after_auto_pre_play_phase_entered` (powers.py:3763) -- ALSO strictly after `after_side_turn_start` in the same turn (player.py:235 then :241-243). So on the turn Relax is applied (by either route), that turn's own `after_side_turn_start` has already passed before the power exists; the power is only ever checked for removal on a LATER turn, at which point Creature.BeforeTurnStart has already re-snapshotted AmountOnTurnStart to the power's then-current (non-zero, unchanged since application) amount -- so the C# guard would read `!= 0` and remove it anyway, agreeing with the sim's unconditional removal. UNREACHABLE by any ported route; a future auto-play mechanism wired to fire BETWEEN BeforeTurnStart and after_side_turn_start (none currently exist) would need this fixed.

guards.what: Phase collapse in the sim's single post-draw slot
guards.rationale: STALE 2026-07-30 (round 11), CLOSED. The premise -- 'the sim's on_player_turn_started is a single slot serving THREE distinct C# phases' -- is no longer true; re-read against today's code rather than trusted from the inherited prose (CONTRACT rule: re-execute the witness first). The sim now has FOUR separately-dispatched, correctly-ordered turn-start hook slots mirroring C#'s CombatManager.cs sequence one-for-one: `on_player_turn_start` (hooks.py:670-678, Hook.BeforeHandDraw, 'inside SetupPlayerTurn... after AfterEnergyReset and before ModifyHandDraw and the draw'), `on_player_turn_started` (hooks.py:680-694, Hook.AfterPlayerTurnStart, 'the LAST line of SetupPlayerTurn... runs after that player's hand draw'), `after_side_turn_start` (hooks.py:696-708, Hook.AfterSideTurnStart, 'CombatManager.cs:522... fired once for the whole side AFTER every SetupPlayerTurn has finished'), and `after_auto_pre_play_phase_entered` (hooks.py:710+, Hook.AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered, 'entered strictly after Hook.AfterSideTurnStart and the orb queue'). EXECUTED: read player.py:187-244's `start_turn`, which dispatches them in exactly this order -- `before_side_turn_start` (:200) -> block clear/`on_block_cleared` (:223) -> `_setup_player_turn` (:231, itself firing `on_player_turn_start` then the draw then `on_player_turn_started` internally per hooks.py:670-694's own docstrings) -> `after_side_turn_start` (:235) -> `after_auto_pre_play_phase_entered` (:243, gated on `not self.is_dead`, matching CombatManager.cs:566's dead-player skip). hooks.py:680-694's own docstring documents the split explicitly: 'This used to double as the player-side Hook.AfterSideTurnStart... 18 of the listeners parked here were really that one. See after_side_turn_start.' This is the round-5 turn_structure campaign's work (memory: 'seam/turn_structure has ZERO open gaps; new PlayerTurnPhase / setup-window / two-exit combat-end machinery'), landed after this guard's text was drafted. DrawCardsNextTurnPower itself now lives in the CORRECT slot (`after_side_turn_start`, this record's own AfterSideTurnStart hook entry, re-settled this same pass) rather than the collapsed one. The relative order of this power and every other turn-start power is therefore fixed by C#'s phase structure, not by hook-registration order, for the four phases the sim now separates. Cross-reference note (binding rule 3 does not apply -- this is this record's OWN guard, not a shared mechanism id with hook_dispatch/G3 or turn_structure/G8): those two records' broader Early/Late-pass and AutoPostPlay findings are out of scope here and not asserted closed by this entry, only THIS power's own exposure to the collapse, which is gone.
